equipment.name: Survival Pills (10 days)
equipment.effect: Nutrient pills. Keep you alive. Reduces max MORALE by 1 for the day (non-cumulative). "Contains 100% of your daily requirements." Contains nothing else.

equipment.name: Survival Pills + Flavor (10 days)
equipment.effect: Same nutritional content. Someone at the factory cared just enough. No MORALE penalty. "Now with real flavor molecules."

equipment.name: NutriMax Ultra Pro (10 days)
equipment.effect: "200% more nutrition. Bioavailable nano-peptides. Endorsed by professionals." Same effect as Survival Pills + Flavor. The box is very shiny.

equipment.name: Cheap Meal (1 day)
equipment.effect: Synthesized protein slab and nutrient broth. Sustains you. Nothing more.

equipment.name: Quality Meal (1 day)
equipment.effect: Properly prepared synth cuisine. Removes the -1 MORALE penalty from eating cheap for the day.

equipment.name: Luxury Meal (1 day)
equipment.effect: Exquisite synth cuisine from a real chef. Removes MORALE penalties from poor living conditions for the day. Worth bragging about.

equipment.name: Uncloned Meal (1 sitting)
equipment.effect: Genuine biological ingredients, actual meat, actual vegetables, actual spices from something that lived. Players who have never had real food must pass a WILLPOWER check or spend the rest of the scene talking about it.

equipment.name: Premium Void Water
equipment.effect: "Sourced from the molecular void between star systems. Purified beyond purity. Tastes like nothing because nothing is perfect." It is water. Genuinely excellent marketing.

equipment.name: Synthetic Truffle Experience Kit
equipment.effect: A small capsule and a pamphlet that walks you through experiencing synthetic truffle at a "molecular sensory level." Comes with a tiny spoon.

equipment.name: Water Fabricator
equipment.effect: Produces drinking water from atmospheric oxygen. Meets basic hydration indefinitely in standard environments.

equipment.name: Auto-Kitchen Unit
equipment.effect: Automated meal synthesizer. Eliminates daily food costs while stocked. Stock refill: 2,000 cr per 10-day week.

equipment.name: Booze, Cheap (Ishtar Gold)
equipment.effect: Barely qualifies as spirits. Gets the job done. "Smooth finish" is printed on the label. It is not smooth.

equipment.name: Booze, Branded (Damph Cold)
equipment.effect: A dark sub-zero lager brewed on Damph, a coronthia mining world of near-absolute temperatures. The process uses the planet's extreme cold rather than fighting it. Genuinely drinkable.

equipment.name: Cryobrew (Damph Cold Reserve)
equipment.effect: The premium expression. Brewed in Damph's deepest facilities over months of slow fermentation. Crystalline clarity, faint mineral aftertaste from the coronthia-rich geology. "Brewed where the universe nearly stops." A collector subculture exists around vintage batches.

equipment.name: Booze, Top Shelf
equipment.effect: Quality synth spirits. Something to actually sip.

equipment.name: Booze, Uncloned
equipment.effect: Fermented and distilled from actual biological source material. Connoisseurs can taste the difference. Everyone else pretends they can too.

equipment.name: Synth-Wine (bottle)
equipment.effect: Algorithmically balanced fermentation simulation. Pairs well with everything because it was designed to. "Notes of oak, blackcurrant, and mathematical optimization."

equipment.name: Void Gin
equipment.effect: Clear spirits with trace zero-g distillation crystallization. Faint mineral aftertaste. Fashionable in upper-district bars. The bottle is genuinely beautiful. The contents justify it.

equipment.name: Brewer's Supply
equipment.effect: Full home brewing setup. DC 2 to produce a drinkable batch (1 week fermentation, 2 hours active work). DC 4 for something worth selling. DC 6 for something a connoisseur would respect. Also purifies water as a byproduct.

equipment.name: Cigarettes
equipment.effect: Synth-tobacco. An ancient habit that survived three galactic wars and corporate consolidation.

equipment.name: Cigars, Standard
equipment.effect: Pressed synth-leaf. Takes the edge off a bad day. No mechanical effect, but some things don't need one.

equipment.name: Giga-GIG
equipment.effect: "Special" cigars. MORALE rolls are lucky for 1 scene but you lose 1 PHYSIQUE for the duration. The packaging just says "ENJOY" in very large letters.

equipment.name: Stim-Patch
equipment.effect: Caffeine and focus compound. Removes fatigue penalties for 1 scene. No combat effect. Sold in vending machines next to the coffee.

equipment.name: Synth-Calm
equipment.effect: Over-the-counter anxiety suppressant. Removes stress-based MORALE penalties for 1 scene. "For when life is a lot." Popular among corporate workers, transit pilots, and anyone who reads the news.

equipment.name: Ghost Smoke
equipment.effect: Aerosol vapor with mild psychedelic compounds. Perception of time slows noticeably for 1 scene. No mechanical effect, purely recreational. Technically legal in most jurisdictions. Technically.

equipment.name: Dust (pinch)
equipment.effect: Powdered neural stimulant, short-duration euphoria. Immediately recovers 1 MORALE. Addictive, each use after the first requires a DC 2 WILLPOWER check or the character craves another within the scene. Corporations have decided regulating this isn't profitable.

equipment.name: Null (dose)
equipment.effect: Dissociative compound. Numbs emotional pain completely for 1 scene. Lose access to MORALE-based abilities during that time. Nothing hurts. Nothing matters either. Originally developed as a corporate stress management tool. Liability waivers still ship with every dose.

equipment.name: Bliss Chip (single use)
equipment.effect: Neural stimulation patch worn behind the ear. Engineered euphoria for 2 hours, no physiological footprint. Beloved by those who want a clean high. "No hangover. No comedown. No personality."

equipment.name: Red Sand
equipment.effect: Biopharma compound from a handful of dark space systems. Activates dormant neural pathways for 1 scene, WITS treated as 2 higher. Afterward: WITS treated as 2 lower until next REST. The crash is non-negotiable.

equipment.name: Chemist Supply
equipment.effect: Full chemistry workbench. DC 3 to synthesize standard pharmaceuticals and recreational compounds. DC 5 for restricted compounds. DC 6 for poisons. Requires knowledge and raw ingredients.

equipment.name: Clothing, Cheap
equipment.effect: Basic functional wear. Common among prisoners, refugees, and people having a very bad week.

equipment.name: Clothing, Standard
equipment.effect: Typical street clothing. Integrated climate micro-adjustment, self-cleaning routines. You look like a person.

equipment.name: Clothing, Formal
equipment.effect: Appropriate for professional and social occasions. Removes social penalty in formal settings.

equipment.name: Clothing, Designer
equipment.effect: Exclusive looks. Recognizable to those who know. Removes social penalty when appearance matters in elite circles. "You're not paying for the clothes. You're paying for the conversation they start."

equipment.name: Clothing, Uncloned Fiber
equipment.effect: Garments from actual biological textiles. The feel is unlike anything synthesized. Removes social penalty in the presence of anyone who recognizes what they're wearing. The kind of thing people remember years later.

equipment.name: Corpo Uniform (generic)
equipment.effect: Someone else's logo. Someone else's colors. Surprisingly effective at making people ignore you in corporate spaces.

equipment.name: High-Vis Worker Suit
equipment.effect: Bright environmental work gear. Nobody questions the maintenance worker. Removes social penalty when moving through industrial or utility areas.

equipment.name: Smartwear Underlayer
equipment.effect: Nano-thread underlayer worn beneath any clothing. Self-regulates temperature, monitors vital signs, datacom integration. The last thing between you and discomfort in extreme climates.

equipment.name: Adaptive Camouflage Suit
equipment.effect: Full-body suit shifting pattern and color in real time to match surroundings. Removes penalty for lacking cover in open terrain when stationary. Moving breaks adaptation, 1 round to re-adapt after stopping.

equipment.name: Exo-Brace Frame
equipment.effect: Lightweight powered exoskeleton worn over clothing. Removes ENCUMBRANCE penalty for carrying heavy loads. Provides no armor.

equipment.name: Void-Rated Environment Suit
equipment.effect: Full sealed suit, 12 hours life support, rated for long-duration vacuum and hostile atmospheres. Integrated datacom interface, basic CCTV output. Not designed for combat but will survive it briefly.

equipment.name: Lingerie / Intimate Apparel
equipment.effect: From budget to spectacular. No mechanical effect unless your GM is generous. Available in synthetic and, for the absurdly wealthy, genuine biological fabrics.

equipment.name: Fetish & Specialty Wear
equipment.effect: The 56th century has not simplified human desire. Wide range of materials, functions, and purposes. Discretely packaged. No questions asked. No mechanical effect.

equipment.name: Armorsmith Tools
equipment.effect: DC 3 to repair damaged armor or resize for a different race. DC 5 to install an armor mod. DC 6 to fabricate from raw materials.

equipment.name: Weaponsmith's Workbench
equipment.effect: DC 3 to repair a weapon. DC 4 to install a weapon mod. DC 6 to fabricate a weapon from components.

equipment.name: Tailor's Tools
equipment.effect: DC 2 to repair or resize clothing. DC 4 to work nano-material garments. DC 5 to construct armor-integrated soft clothing.

equipment.name: Tinker's Tools
equipment.effect: DC 2 to build basic devices from omni-gel (motion sensors, light sources, micro-timers). DC 5 for a functional micro-EMP or signal jammer.

equipment.name: Hacking Tools
equipment.effect: Physical bypass toolkit for security systems, encrypted hardware locks, and hardwired terminals. Removes penalty for hardware intrusion without a datacom.

equipment.name: Thieves' Tools
equipment.effect: Manual bypass for traps, security doors, and mechanical locks. Removes penalty for non-electronic intrusion. Preferred by professionals who don't trust their own hacking.

equipment.name: Medical Kit (basic)
equipment.effect: 5 uses. DC equal to target's current wounds, on success restore 3 HEALTH or MORALE.

equipment.name: Medical Kit (full)
equipment.effect: 10 uses. As basic kit, plus removes AILMENTS and LIGHT TRAUMAS on DC 5+.

equipment.name: Cook's Utensils
equipment.effect: DC 2 for a Quality Meal without an Auto-Kitchen. DC 5 for something resembling a Luxury Meal. DC 6 for something a critic wouldn't embarrass themselves reviewing.

equipment.name: Artist Tools
equipment.effect: Paint, draw, sculpt, design. DC 3 for something presentable. DC 6 for something gallery-worthy.

equipment.name: Musical Instrument
equipment.effect: You know how to play it. DC 3 for a passable performance. DC 6 to move someone who didn't expect to be moved.

equipment.name: Gaming Set
equipment.effect: Everything needed for Skyllian-5 and games of chance. The house always wins, unless you bring this.

equipment.name: Disguise Kit
equipment.effect: Cosmetic modification tools for adopting a false identity. Removes penalty on disguise checks. DC 4 to pass casual inspection. DC 6 for a thorough one.

equipment.name: Duct-Tape
equipment.effect: It's Duct-Tape.

equipment.name: Duct-Tape: Make a Friend
equipment.effect: Extra-strong, double-sided. Requires external remover to detach. "New friends, forever."

equipment.name: Duct-Tape: Easy Grip
equipment.effect: Extra-extra strong. Questions are being asked about why you need this. No one is answering.

equipment.name: Duct-Tape: Dilythium
equipment.effect: Ship-hull grade. Can patch a hull breach. Duct-tape remover sold separately at 200,000 cr.

equipment.name: Sleep Replicator
equipment.effect: Personal unit. Resets fatigue and grants 30 additional hours of autonomy in 5 minutes. Costs 1 MORALE unless calibrated for a single user (calibration included at purchase).

equipment.name: Emergency Bivouac Pod
equipment.effect: Single-use pressurized tube. Deploys in 1 round, fits 1 person. Rated for vacuum and extreme temperatures. 8 hours life support. Qualifies as REST.

equipment.name: Field Shelter MK-II
equipment.effect: 4-person modular tent, 10 minutes assembly. Climate-controlled, passively blocks electronic surveillance from outside. Qualifies as REST.

equipment.name: Hab-Unit Alpha
equipment.effect: Deployable prefab room. 1 hour assembly, power-independent 72 hours. Bed, climate control, physical lock, local BBS terminal. Full REST.

equipment.name: Orbital Drop Shelter
equipment.effect: Military-grade, rated to survive atmospheric drop entry. Emergency beacon, 1-week life support, reinforced lock. Full REST.

equipment.name: Omni-Filter Mask
equipment.effect: 6 hours filtration against toxins, gas, and airborne pathogens. Negates GAS ailment. Removes penalty to operate in contaminated atmospheres.

equipment.name: Rebreather Unit
equipment.effect: Sealed breathing, 4 hours of oxygen. Removes penalty to operate in airless environments for its duration.

equipment.name: Emergency Vac Suit
equipment.effect: Lightweight, not combat-rated. 2 hours life support. Removes vacuum exposure penalties for its duration.

equipment.name: Grav Boots
equipment.effect: Magnetic-assist footwear. Removes zero-g and low-gravity movement penalties.

equipment.name: Thermal Blanket
equipment.effect: Reflective emergency foil. Prevents hypothermia. Obscures heat signature from thermal sensors for 1 scene.

equipment.name: Nano-Rope (50m)
equipment.effect: Carbon nanotube cordage rated 5,000 kg. Cuttable only by industrial tools or high-powered energy weapons.

equipment.name: Grapple Launcher
equipment.effect: Fires nano-rope up to 40m, rated for 3 people simultaneously. Removes climbing distance penalties for the anchor point.

equipment.name: Portable Atmosphere Tester
equipment.effect: Instant atmospheric readout, oxygen, toxins, pressure, radiation in 1 round. Removes penalties for operating blind in unknown atmospheres.

equipment.name: Radiation Badge
equipment.effect: Passive cumulative radiation monitor. Changes color at danger threshold. Single-use.

equipment.name: Emergency Beacon
equipment.effect: Distress broadcast on all emergency frequencies, range: entire star system. Cannot be obfuscated. Guaranteed Alliance response in controlled space, response time unpredictable elsewhere.

equipment.name: Personal Locator Chip
equipment.effect: Subcutaneous GPS position chip. Broadcasting by default. DC 3 CYBERINTEL to disable remotely. Illegal to implant in another person without consent.

equipment.name: Tactical Flashlight
equipment.effect: High-output beam. Removes darkness penalties within 30m. Direct flash forces WILLPOWER check or target is DAZED for 1 round.

equipment.name: Nightvision Visor
equipment.effect: Full-spectrum low-light optics. Removes all darkness penalties up to 200m.

equipment.name: Thermal Visor
equipment.effect: Detects heat signatures through thin walls and smoke within 30m. Removes concealment penalty against biological targets in range.

equipment.name: Optic Zoom Lens
equipment.effect: 10x optical zoom. Removes long-range observation penalties beyond 100m.

equipment.name: Smoke Canister
equipment.effect: Visual and thermal obscurement cloud, 5m radius, 1 scene. All attackers targeting through smoke suffer LARGE penalty to hit.

equipment.name: Holo-Projector (personal)
equipment.effect: Projects a 1m holographic image, decoys, presentations, entertainment. 1 scene per charge.

equipment.name: Derelict Squat
equipment.effect: Not REST. DC 3 RESILIENCE, pass: recover as Capsule Pod. Fail: nothing.

equipment.name: Capsule Pod (per night)
equipment.effect: A tube with a screen. REST, recovers ENDURANCE in HEALTH and WILLPOWER in MORALE.

equipment.name: Hostel Bunk (per night)
equipment.effect: Shared dorm. REST, but roll DC 2 WILLPOWER or lose 1 MORALE from the experience.

equipment.name: Standard Room (per night)
equipment.effect: Private, climate-controlled, physical lock, local BBS terminal. Full REST.

equipment.name: Corporate Suite (per night)
equipment.effect: Full REST. Removes social penalty when hosting meetings here.

equipment.name: Luxury Penthouse (per night)
equipment.effect: Full REST + 2 bonus MORALE recovery. Private security on call, dedicated private network node.

equipment.name: Hab Block Unit (per month)
equipment.effect: Minimum-spec. Climate control, physical lock, shared building BBS terminal. Full REST.

equipment.name: Mid-City Apartment (per month)
equipment.effect: Secure entry, private parking, own BBS terminal. Full REST. Removes social penalty when hosting.

equipment.name: Upper District Apartment (per month)
equipment.effect: Secure district, concierge, CCTV, private network node. Full REST. Removes social penalty when hosting important contacts.

equipment.name: Corporate Condo (per month)
equipment.effect: Cleaning drones, security, private gym, private network node. Full REST + 1 bonus MORALE recovery.

equipment.name: Private Estate (per month)
equipment.effect: Grounds, staff quarters, garages, private docking pad. Full REST + 2 bonus MORALE recovery. Security staff not included.

equipment.name: Security System (basic)
equipment.effect: Alarm, cameras, mag-lock doors. DC 4 HACKING or TECHNOLOGY to bypass without triggering.

equipment.name: Security System (advanced)
equipment.effect: As basic, plus motion-sensitive turret hardpoints (weapons not included), biometric entry, tamper-detection AI. DC 6 to bypass. Alerts owner datacom on any intrusion attempt.

equipment.name: Panic Button
equipment.effect: Single-press emergency alert to a private security contractor. Response time varies by district.

equipment.name: Safe Room
equipment.effect: Reinforced panic room. EXTREME PHYSICAL and ENERGY defense against attacks on the room. 48 hours independent air supply, internal comms terminal.

equipment.name: Airlock Upgrade
equipment.effect: Converts any standard door into a dual-seal airlock with biometric lock and pressure equalization. DC 5 to breach without explosives.

equipment.name: Stasis Locker
equipment.effect: Preserves biological material or valuables indefinitely. Power loss ends stasis immediately.

equipment.name: Holo-Wall System
equipment.effect: Full-surface configurable holographic walls. Scenery, art, entertainment. Pure quality of life.

equipment.name: Signal Jammer (residential)
equipment.effect: Blocks all external network signals from penetrating your residence. Nothing gets in, nothing gets out. Manual toggle.

equipment.name: EMP Hardening (room)
equipment.effect: Faraday installation for a single room. Your devices still work when everything else doesn't.

equipment.name: Basic Furnishings
equipment.effect: A bed, a chair, a table. Everything you need. Nothing you want.

equipment.name: Standard Furnishings
equipment.effect: Proper bed, couch, desk, kitchen unit. Comfortable and complete.

equipment.name: Quality Furnishings
equipment.effect: Real materials, considered design. Removes social penalty when hosting in your home.

equipment.name: Luxury Furnishings
equipment.effect: Commissioned pieces, premium synthetic fabrics. Removes social penalty when hosting high-status contacts.

equipment.name: Uncloned Wood Furniture
equipment.effect: Actual wood from an actual tree. The grain is real. The weight is real. People have been murdered for less. Removes social penalty in the presence of anyone who recognizes what they're looking at.

equipment.name: Entertainment System
equipment.effect: Holographic display, haptic audio, gaming interface, BBS access. Standard fixture in any self-respecting hab.

equipment.name: Personal BBS Terminal
equipment.effect: Dedicated hardware terminal for private local network sessions. More stable than a datacom for extended use.

equipment.name: Personal Garden Pod
equipment.effect: Sealed hydroponic enclosure. Grows actual living plants. Produces a harvest of uncloned ingredients per month (~50,000 cr value). Requires water and power.

equipment.name: Pleasure Simulation Suite
equipment.effect: Full-sensory haptic immersion chamber. Neural-grade fidelity for any simulated experience. Recovers 1 additional MORALE during REST if used before sleep. Manufacturer warranty void if used more than 4 hours per day. No further comment.

equipment.name: Neural Comfort Pillow
equipment.effect: Mild neural feedback cushion. Suppresses background stress during sleep. Recovers 1 additional MORALE during REST. "Clinically tested. Results may vary. Side effects include excessive optimism."

equipment.name: Quantum Alignment Pendant
equipment.effect: "Calibrated to your personal quantum field. Harmonizes bio-resonance. Worn by 3 celebrities." A rock in a branded box. A very nice box. No mechanical effect.

equipment.name: Bio-Sync Sleep Optimizer
equipment.effect: A headband with blinking lights that "reads your neural patterns and optimizes sleep cycles." The blinking lights are not connected to anything.

equipment.name: Holographic Pet
equipment.effect: A small projector housing a digital companion animal. Customizable species, personality, and name. Responds to voice and gesture. No mechanical effect. Players have cried when these have been destroyed.

equipment.name: Personalized Star Chart
equipment.effect: Your birth system or any chosen system rendered in precise holographic detail, framed for display. Pure fluff. Genuinely beautiful.

equipment.name: Memorial Capsule
equipment.effect: A small sealed vessel for meaningful mementos. Includes a launch service, your capsule is sent into a stable deep space orbit of your choosing, effectively forever. Popular as gifts and commemorations.

equipment.name: Luxury Gift Basket
equipment.effect: A curated selection of premium consumables, trinkets, and branded items. Tier scales with price (25,000–200,000 cr). A universally understood gesture across all cultures in the Alliance. The GM will notice.

equipment.name: Custom Datacom Skin
equipment.effect: A custom housing or casing for your datacom. Purely cosmetic. Tells people exactly who you are before you speak. (3,000–50,000 cr depending on design)

equipment.name: Pressed Alien Flora (framed)
equipment.effect: Exotic specimens from non-Alliance worlds, preserved in sealed environment frames. Each one is unique. Popular among explorers and collectors.

equipment.name: Antique Music Box (reproduction)
equipment.effect: A mechanical instrument that plays a tune using physical pins and a vibrating comb. No electronics. No network. Just gears. People find this deeply unsettling or deeply moving. Rarely both.

equipment.name: Decorative Art (print)
equipment.effect: Mass-produced holographic wall art. Millions of identical copies. Cats are still inexplicably popular 5,600 years later.

equipment.name: Decorative Art (original)
equipment.effect: Original commissioned piece by a living artist. Unique.

equipment.name: Decorative Art (uncloned medium)
equipment.effect: Organic paint on organic canvas, or carved stone. The rarity is the material.

equipment.name: Rugs & Flooring (synthetic)
equipment.effect: Nano-fiber, self-cleaning, configurable pattern. Genuinely nice.

equipment.name: Rugs & Flooring (uncloned fiber)
equipment.effect: Woven from actual wool, cotton, or silk. The texture is unlike anything synthesized.

equipment.name: Uncloned Food Collection
equipment.effect: Curated genuine non-synthesized ingredients, enough for 10 meals. Players who have never had real food must pass a WILLPOWER check or spend the rest of the scene talking about it.

equipment.name: Commemorative Knick-Knacks
equipment.effect: Souvenirs, trinkets, novelties from across the galaxy. No mechanical effect. Essential to feeling like a person.

equipment.name: Private Courier (same-day)
equipment.effect: Discreet physical delivery anywhere on a station or city district within hours. Price scales with distance, urgency, and how few questions you want asked (2,000–20,000 cr).

equipment.name: Legal Counsel (per hour)
equipment.effect: A licensed Alliance attorney. Reduces legal penalties during formal proceedings. Price reflects specialization, corporate law costs more than traffic violations (10,000–100,000 cr/hr).

equipment.name: Fixer Introduction (one-time)
equipment.effect: A warm introduction to a connected fixer who can source restricted goods, arrange meetings, or make problems disappear. Does not guarantee help, just that they'll take your call.

equipment.name: Hab Cleaning Service (per month)
equipment.effect: Cleaning drones visit weekly. No mechanical effect. Your landlord approves.

equipment.name: Tailoring & Alterations
equipment.effect: Resizes, repairs, or modifies any clothing item. High-end tailors can make standard attire pass as designer with a DC 4 SOCIAL check (5,000–40,000 cr).

equipment.name: Private Security Escort (per hour)
equipment.effect: Two licensed armed guards accompany you for the duration. They deter, report, and die when it matters. Useful for moving valuables or making a statement.

equipment.name: Concierge Network Subscription (per month)
equipment.effect: A human concierge handles your administrative existence, permit renewals, BBS subscriptions, delivery coordination, appointment booking. Removes all the boring parts of being alive. Mostly.

equipment.name: Ship Detailing
equipment.effect: Full cosmetic restoration and customization of your ship's exterior and interior. No mechanical effect. Your crew will notice. Your enemies will notice. Customs will ask more questions (50,000–500,000 cr).

equipment.name: Augmentation Consultation
equipment.effect: An initial evaluation and procedure quote from a licensed augmentation surgeon. Does not include any work. Useful for knowing what you're getting into before committing.

equipment.name: Identity Verification Service
equipment.effect: Confirms the authenticity of an identity document against the Alliance registry. Ironically, also the primary tool used by forgers to know exactly how good their work needs to be.

equipment.name: Bounty Posting (per target)
equipment.effect: File a private bounty through a licensed intermediary. Sets a reward for any Rank 1+ Bounty Hunter who delivers the target. Minimum 100,000 cr. Price is the reward, not a fee.

equipment.name: Bar Tab (evening)
equipment.effect: An evening at a bar, dive to upscale. Price reflects the establishment (500–50,000 cr). No mechanical effect unless something happens, which it usually does.

equipment.name: Live Performance (ticket)
equipment.effect: Music, theater, gladiatorial spectacle, or whatever constitutes art in your district. Single admission. Removes 1 MORALE penalty from poor living conditions for the day (1,000–500,000 cr).

equipment.name: Private Event Hire
equipment.effect: Hire a venue, performer, or full event package for a private gathering. Removes social penalty when hosting events for important contacts.

equipment.name: Sim-Arena Session (public)
equipment.effect: 2 hours in a public combat simulation arena. Popular for training, entertainment, and settling disputes that don't need to be real. No mechanical effect in actual combat, it's just a game.

equipment.name: Sim-Arena Session (private)
equipment.effect: A private booking. Your scenario, your rules, your guests. No one watching unless you want them to.

equipment.name: Holographic Theatre Subscription (per month)
equipment.effect: Unlimited access to the local holographic theatre catalog, film, drama, immersive experiences. Connects through your BBS terminal or entertainment system.

equipment.name: Companion Services (per hour)
equipment.effect: Professional social companions, licensed in most Alliance jurisdictions. Range of services and specializations. Discretion guaranteed. No mechanical effect (10,000–200,000 cr).

equipment.name: Professional Gambling Establishment
equipment.effect: Entry to a licensed gambling house. SOCIAL or WITS check to avoid losing money, the house edge is real. High-stakes tables require UNCOMMON access. Winnings and losses are entirely up to the GM and the dice.

equipment.name: Taxi
equipment.effect: Ground taxi service. Price per minute of transit. Available in any populated area.

equipment.name: City Mass Transit (single trip)
equipment.effect: One tram, tube, or transit pod trip within a city. Cheap and reliable.

equipment.name: Small Car
equipment.effect: Compact economy vehicle, mass-produced. Gets you there.

equipment.name: Cheap Motorcycle
equipment.effect: Entry-level bike. Functional, loud, and distinctly unglamorous.

equipment.name: Mid-Range Motorcycle
equipment.effect: A proper bike. Comfortable, fast enough to matter, good-looking enough to park visibly.

equipment.name: Mid-Size Sedan
equipment.effect: Comfortable and reliable. The choice of people who have made it but aren't showing off about it.

equipment.name: Racing Motorcycle
equipment.effect: Built for speed, not comfort. Turns heads. Occasionally turns the rider.

equipment.name: Luxury Car
equipment.effect: Premium vehicle, hand-assembled, whisper-quiet. Deeply impractical for anything involving gunfire.

equipment.name: Supercar
equipment.effect: Performance engineering at its extreme. The kind of vehicle that makes traffic enforcement reconsider their life choices.

equipment.name: Collector's Vehicle
equipment.effect: A pre-war vehicle, a hand-built exotic, or something with genuine provenance. Price is floor only, the right buyer pays more.

equipment.name: Public Takeoff/Landing Shuttle (ticket)
equipment.effect: Shared shuttle to and from the nearest spaceport. Scheduled departures.

equipment.name: Public Transport to Another Planet
equipment.effect: Scheduled passenger transport between planets within the same system. Standard class.

equipment.name: Public Transport to Another System
equipment.effect: Inter-system travel in cryo. Price per gate traversed. You'll be unconscious for it. Most people consider this a feature.

equipment.name: Private Takeoff/Landing Shuttle
equipment.effect: Chartered private version of the public shuttle. Your schedule, your privacy.

equipment.name: Private Transport to Another Planet
equipment.effect: Private chartered planetary transport. Comfortable and discreet.

equipment.name: Private Transport to Another System
equipment.effect: Private inter-system travel. Cryo optional, your choice. Price per gate.

equipment.name: Memory Backup
equipment.effect: A full backup of your character that can be inserted into any compatible body. Backups are single-use only. Cost increases by 1,000 cr per point of experience the character has accumulated. Stored in a licensed secure vault.

equipment.name: Clone, Bargain Bin
equipment.effect: A re-used, very old body of poor quality that once belonged to someone else. It's yours now. -2 to all stats. Will wear out in 1–2 years. No warranty. No refunds.

equipment.name: Clone, Cheap
equipment.effect: A cheap generic manufactured clone. -1 to all stats. Expected model durability of 5 years.

equipment.name: Clone, Average
equipment.effect: A well-made clone. Large model selection, no custom features. Model durability expected at 10 years.

equipment.name: Clone, High End
equipment.effect: A high-grade clone, fully customizable, you choose how you look. Model durability around 20 years.

equipment.name: Clone, Real
equipment.effect: An actual clone of yourself, grown and preserved just for you. A perfect biological copy in every way. No stat modifications. No durability limit, it's your real body. The price reflects that.

equipment.name: Clone Repair
equipment.effect: Refurbish and repair your existing body. Repairs all damage and extends durability by 1 year. Price is 20% of the original clone's purchase value.

equipment.name: Civic Personhood Certificate, Tier 1
equipment.effect: Colloquially: Right to Live. The foundational civil document of Alliance space. Without it you have no legal existence whatsoever, you own nothing, you sign nothing, you receive no medical rights, you cannot be the victim of any crime. Killing an unpermitted person carries no more legal consequence than destroying stray property. Most citizens are born into Tier 1 and renew annually. Criminal convictions and certain corporate actions can revoke it.

equipment.name: Alliance Citizen ID
equipment.effect: Biometric identification card. Required for most legal transactions. Worthless without a valid CPC attached.

equipment.name: Forged Identity (basic)
equipment.effect: Passes casual inspection. LARGE penalty on serious background checks. Includes a forged Tier 1 CPC.

equipment.name: Forged Identity (deep cover)
equipment.effect: Full legend, employment history, partial biometric masking, registry entry. DC 6 to identify as forged. Includes forged Tier 1 CPC.

equipment.name: Firearms Permit
equipment.effect: Legal right to carry one concealed sidearm in Alliance space. Removes search-and-seizure risk for a single handgun. Annual renewal.

equipment.name: Security Contractor License
equipment.effect: Licensed private security status. Removes legal penalty for carrying weapons on contracted assignments. Annual renewal.

equipment.name: Bounty Hunter License, Rank 1
equipment.effect: Entry-level. Legal to apprehend flagged targets. Access to low-clearance Alliance warrant databases. Annual renewal.

equipment.name: Bounty Hunter License, Rank 3
equipment.effect: Mid-grade. Access to medium-clearance warrants. Removes legal penalty on Alliance law enforcement cooperation. Annual renewal.

equipment.name: Bounty Hunter License, Rank 5
equipment.effect: Top civilian tier. High-value warrants, lethal force authorization. Removes legal penalty for use of force in apprehension. Annual renewal.

equipment.name: Medical Practice License
equipment.effect: Certified practitioner. Removes penalty on formal Medicine checks. Legal right to purchase Restricted medical items.

equipment.name: Explosives Handling License
equipment.effect: Removes legal penalties during inspections when carrying licensed explosive materials.

equipment.name: Augmentation Surgery License
equipment.effect: Legal authorization for augmentation procedures outside certified facilities. Without it all augmentation work is criminal surgery regardless of patient consent.

equipment.name: TRONIK Clearance, Level 1
equipment.effect: Not purchasable. Government-issued clearance for TRONIK containment and research. Equivalent to nuclear/chemical warfare handling authorization. Possessing TRONIK materials without this is a capital offense in most Alliance jurisdictions. Even acknowledging its existence publicly is inadvisable.

options.name: Fragmented Defenses
options.desc: Provides protection against BREACHED but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

options.name: Armor-Bot
options.desc: Adds in a DRONE controller that provides 1 CPU that can be use exclusivelly for DRONES

options.name: Autofit
options.desc: Adds the UNIVERSAL trait to an armor

options.name: Compact Design
options.desc: Reduce FORCEFIELD or DATACOM size by 1 category. Cannot reduce an item under TINY.

options.name: Compact-it!
options.desc: Fold your armor as a COMPLEX action when not worn. Folded size for Light, Medium and Heavy armor result into a SMALL, MEDIUM or LARGE item.

options.name: Hardening
options.desc: Adds the HARDENED special property but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

options.name: Hazmat Treatment
options.desc: Adds the INNOCULATION special property. This option requires OPT+.

options.name: Heat Coating
options.desc: Adds the INSULATING special property but you get a SMALL penalty to SOAK checks.

options.name: Hidden storage
options.desc: Item now has a SMALL compartment that is hidden. Grants 5 passive CONCEALMENT to anything inside.

options.name: Shatter plates
options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on PHYSICAL damage attacks.

options.name: Reflective deflectors
options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on ENERGY damage attacks.

options.name: Null emissions
options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on TECH damage attacks.

options.name: Warded construction
options.desc: This defense ignores the effect of DP on SPIRITUAL damage attacks.

options.name: Light Plates
options.desc: HEAVY Armors now count as MEDIUM and MEDIUM as LIGHT. Maximum SOAK is permanently reduced by 2.

options.name: Pressurized
options.desc: Gain the SPACE special ability but size increase by 1 category. For armor this increases encumbrance by 1 category.

options.name: Quick escape
options.desc: Removing this ARMOR or FORCEFIELD can be done as a Quick action but you need to spend a SCENE restoring your item before putting it on again.

options.name: Symbiotic Defenses
options.desc: After taking damage you gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK until next maintenance. If the damage caused a TRAUMA the SOAK bonus is LARGE.

options.name: Vital Guard
options.desc: Your DEFENSE is one tier higher on CRITICAL attacks. (Up to a maximum of HIGH).

options.name: Runic
options.desc: Item is treated as an INTERMEDIATE RELIC that lowers CHI penalties.

options.name: Storage format
options.desc: Item can be compacted when not in use (COMPLEX to pack/unpack). Compacting an item reduces it's size by 1 category (Min. TINY).

options.name: Tactical Inserts
options.desc: Grants AEGIS for up to a SCENE but must be recharged after any SCENE where it prevented any SPECIAL modifier. (Recharge takes 3 NANITES and a SCENE).

options.name: Flawless shields
options.desc: This FORCEFIELD can now ignores critical attacks by expending 2 charges per hit instead of one.

options.name: Weapon mount
options.desc: Your armor removes the penalties for RECOIL, if your armored is also POWERED, you remove the penalties for BRACE as well.

options.name: Cloaking
options.desc: Adds the CLOAK special ability to this DEVICE.

options.name: Dead's man switch
options.desc: Item can self destruct on a trigger condition set by its user. Item's explosion deals 10D [HIGH] PHYSICAL HEALTH damage in a 2m radius.

options.name: Displacement field
options.desc: Provides a SMALL bonus to SPEED checks Vs Ranged attacks. Bonus is negated if you are LOCKED ON.

options.name: Distress beacon
options.desc: Can send out a distress signal that can be seen up to 1 system away

options.name: Flickerfield
options.desc: Adds PHASING to your forcefield

options.name: Jump jets
options.desc: Requires a MEDIUM or LARGE item. You can travel in the air for 1 round at a speed of 8 or break a fall once per SCENE. (SCENE recharge)

options.name: Medi-Bot
options.desc: Item can apply a pre installed DRUG on you (lvl 5 Medical) as FREE ACTION. Requires a COMPLEX action to recharge or replace the expended drug.

options.name: Repellent Systems
options.desc: Zap anyone touching this DEVICE as a QUICK action or predetermined (at purchase) trigger. 7D+2 [HIGH] STUN ENERGY HEALTH damage (Scene recharge)

options.name: Ricochet systems
options.desc: Grenades that land within 1m of you have a additional 5m deviation in a random direction.

options.name: S.A.D Module
options.desc: Spike Accident Detector: Deploys on vehicle crash or terminal velocity falls. Adds 8D SOAK on crash. SCENE recharge.

options.name: Spider Harness
options.desc: Harness, ropes and climbing attachment (LARGE bonus to ATHLETICS checks when climbing)

options.name: Spotlights
options.desc: Item has a built in searchlight, brightly illuminates a 45 degree cone at 250m.

options.name: Explorer package armor
options.desc: Your Armor can now filter toxic or dirty water or recycle existing water extending it for 10 days.

options.name: Explorer package forcefield
options.desc: Your forcefield can now filter toxic gases and extract air out of non breatheable gases. It can also recycle existing air for up to 10 hours.

options.name: Explorer package datacom
options.desc: Your Datacom has a set of specialized nanites and attachments that grant a LARGE bonus to SURVIVAL and SCAVENGE skill checks.

options.name: Tactical Visor
options.desc: Provides fully virtual electronic imaging (user has Type II vision instead of Type I).

options.name: Time Dilation
options.desc: When someone enters MELEE range with you time slows down, you and anyone within your melee range is SLOW. Increase FORCEFIELD DEFENSE to HIGH and gain DUELIST against any melee attacker that is SLOW.

options.name: Maintenance mode
options.desc: Device has built in basic tools required to maintain and repair the device. Removes the need for external tools.

options.name: Trauma unit
options.desc: Device will auto stabilize you if you are DYING and can also emit a distress signal on TRAUMA if configured to do so.

options.name: Anti-Papparazzi
options.desc: Your DISCRETE option now grants 10 CONCEALMENT vs Type II devices (Electronic surveillance).

options.name: Auto-Purge
options.desc: Removes any ongoing damage AILMENTS at the end of the maintenance phase if you have not saved against them already.

options.name: Combat tracker
options.desc: Gain a SMALL bonus to all DEFENSES ATTRIBUTES against any target you have LOCK-ON against.

options.name: Cosmetic Package
options.desc: Allows the device to display any design, texture or logo of your choice. Grants a SMALL bonus if used as part of a disguise.

options.name: Sound Dampeners
options.desc: Careful construction and sound dampening grants this item the INV special modifier (undetectable over 10m) against sound identification

options.name: Drone-Controller
options.desc: Provides 1 CPU but usage is limited for DRONE use only.

options.name: EMP shielded
options.desc: Device is protected from ELECTRO MAGNETIC PULSE (EMP). This does not prevent damage.

options.name: Frangible Plating
options.desc: Grants protection against AR for up to a SCENE but is destroyed after any SCENE where it prevented an AR modifier.

options.name: Gravity controller
options.desc: Device now provides artificial gravity for yourself. You can ignore gravity related difficult terrain.

options.name: Lock-on Jammer
options.desc: CYBERINTEL LOCK-ON attacks against you have a LARGE penalty.

options.name: Luxury Package
options.desc: Item is custom made to be as luxurious as possible is now a LUXURY item and it's design is UNIQUE.

options.name: Memory Bank
options.desc: This item has 3 units of MEMORY storage, this storage has CONCEALMENT 5 vs Type 1 and Type 2 surveillance.

options.name: Repair bots
options.desc: Item has repair nanobots. Spend 1 NANITE and a QUICK action to repair the item or cancel a condition preventing its usage like a critical faillure etc.

options.name: Nano-Reserves
options.desc: ITEM increases your NANITE count by 3

options.name: Overcharge
options.desc: While your FORCEFIELD is recharging any ENERGY attacks you make have its POWER level increased by 1.

options.name: Security Package
options.desc: When outside of a NETWORK this device now has a SYSTEM rating of 5 instead of the default 1.

options.name: Spirit Guard
options.desc: When your defenses are not BREACHED, attempts to bind your SPIRIT receives a LARGE penalty.

options.name: Suit-Up!
options.desc: If applied to a LIGHT ARMOR, you can now put it on as a STANDARD action. If applied to a MEDIUM or HEAVY ARMOR, you instead reduce the time to put them on to 1 round and 2 rounds respectivelly.

options.name: Supercharger
options.desc: If both your forcefield and energy weapon have this option, as a QUICK action you can set one non recharging item to recharge to instantly recharge the other one. Both items must have the same recharge time for this to work.

options.name: Tach-Field
options.desc: Item gains the DISCRETE special modifier but the CONCEALMENT is only 1.

options.name: Professional Calibration
options.desc: SMALL penalty to weapon damage but increase EXPERTISE by 3

options.name: Barrel Mount
options.desc: Allows the weapon to attach small non-combat tools like a flashlight. Inceases weapon size by 1.

options.name: Bayonet
options.desc: Your weapon can produce a KNIFE on demand, paramaters are the same as a regular KNIFE except that the KNIFE damage type will match your WEAPONS base damage type as well. This allows your weapon to be used in MELEE without any penalties.

options.name: Combat grip
options.desc: This DEVICE can be used in melee. Counts as a nightstick if the device is SMALL or MEDIUM and a STAFF if it is LARGER. TINY DEVICES cannot have this option.

options.name: Deflection Field
options.desc: Weapon has a deflection field to help against attacks. Grants a frontal only MEDIUM DEFENSE against all damage types while wielding this weapon.

options.name: Compact Folding
options.desc: Weapon can be compacted (reduce size by 1 category but unusable until expanded). Takes a Quick action to change from compact to full.

options.name: Full Stabilizer
options.desc: Your EXPERTISE roll is LUCKY when using FULL AUTO. Weapon size increase by 1

options.name: Grav compensator
options.desc: Removes the BULKY and RECOIL modifier from a weapon. EXPERTISE is reduced by 3.

options.name: Extended magazine
options.desc: Doubles weapon ammo capacity but increase weapon size class by 1.

options.name: Long barrel
options.desc: Increase WEAPON range to maximum in category. Increase weapon size class by 1.

options.name: Reinforced
options.desc: DEVICE gains the DUR+ special option and EXPERTISE can never drop under 0 (No effect if no EXPERTISE or already under 0)

options.name: Short barrel
options.desc: Reduce WEAPON size by 1 category but LONG RANGE is no longer possible and MEDIUM range has a LARGE penalty to hitl.

options.name: Ammo Selector
options.desc: Munition based weapon can select different kind of ammunitions from the same magazine as a free action.

options.name: Singularity generator
options.desc: Radius of EXPLOSIVE weapons can now exclude one 1x1m area from blast radius.

options.name: Fast Charge Cells
options.desc: Once per SCENE you can bypass your DEVICE RECHARGE time. Doing so instantly recharges the device but for the rest of the SCENE your SKILL/DEFENSE check with that DEVICE have their CRITICAL FAILURE treshold increases by 1.

options.name: Virtual imaging
options.desc: You ignore all visual penalities and type II CONCEALMENT. You are BLIND if your INTERNAL SYSTEM reaches 0.

options.name: Heavy Coils
options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon gains the DP tag but not longer shoots above MEDIUM RANGE range and ammo consumption is DOUBLED.

options.name: Guidance system
options.desc: You can add SMART to any munition based weapon attacks by consuming 3x the normal AMMO.

options.name: Multi-Dimention Coils
options.desc: Your ENERGY weapon fire gains the INV tag or INV+ if it already had INV. Expertise is reduced by 3 points.

options.name: Assasination marker
options.desc: When making PRECISION HITS your CRITICAL range increase by 1. Increases by 2 if you also have LOCK-ON. Weapon can no longer CRITICAL hit on non PRECISION HITS.

options.name: Multi-Detonator
options.desc: Allows user to set exact detonation conditions for a SINGLE USE EXPLOSIVE based on almost anything. Explosive size increase to next category.

options.name: Smart Detonation
options.desc: Weapon will not fire or Explosive will not detonate if a friendly targets would be hit. Prevents all friendly fire.

options.name: Speed reloader
options.desc: You can reduce the reload time of AMMO based weapons by 1 action type (COMPLEX-STANDARD-QUICK). This cannot reduce reload under a quick action.

options.name: Interface Implants
options.desc: DEVICE now requires EVO Cybernetics to use. Gain a SMALL bonus to skill checks with that DEVICE if you activated a CYBERNETIC EVO this ROUND. Bonus increases to LARGE if the activation did not cost MORALE.

options.name: Universal receiver
options.desc: You can use any ammo as long as the category is equal or higher, you get no additional benefits from this.

options.name: Auto-Fixit
options.desc: In the case of a reliability malfunction (critical faillure) this DEVICE automatically fixes itself after 1 round.

options.name: Biometric lock
options.desc: DEVICE has a genetic lock and can only be used by owner or a perfect clone of the owner.

options.name: Grenade attachment
options.desc: Adds a Grenade launcher attachment (see Grenade table) to any medium, large or Ex.large weapon.

options.name: High Explosive
options.desc: Increases EXPLOSIVE POWER to HIGH but reduces radius by half (Not usable if radius is reduced under 1m).

options.name: Hypo Darts
options.desc: Needler weapon now fires medical darts. Damage reduced to STUN. Applies drug effect on a damaging hit. DRUG must be acquired separatly. Reduces needler ammo to a maximum of 1.

options.name: Laser Bayonet
options.desc: ENERGY Weapon can now be used in MELEE with a SMALL penalty , damage and POWER remains the same but it does not trigger RETALIATION.

options.name: Long range attachment
options.desc: Eliminate LONG and MEDIUM range penalty when taking a PRECISION HIT action. Weapon size increase by 1 category.

options.name: Serrated delivery
options.desc: If your PHYSICAL DAMAGE result is a CRITICAL HIT you gain a LARGE damage bonus. Your non CRITICAL result hits have a SMALL damage penalty.

options.name: Single Block accelerator
options.desc: Full auto no longer grants a number of shots equal to expertise result, instead it doubles the expertise bonus as additional damage.

options.name: Sticky coating
options.desc: Grenade will stick to any surface it hits, no deviation. (Athletic DC2 to remove). On critical faillures it sticks to the user.

options.name: Suppressor
options.desc: Removes muzzle flash and lowers noise of PHYSICAL weapons. Gain INV tag when the distance exceeds 10m.

options.name: Tactical computer
options.desc: After hitting a target once you can perform QUICK action to lock-on vs that target (use your ranged roll instead of CYBERINTEL).

options.name: Tripod attachment
options.desc: Your weapon is considered BRACED if you have not moved this round. Weapon size increase by 1

options.name: Charge capacitor
options.desc: Your energy weapon no longer needs to charge before usage (start combat with full AMMO) but your RECHARGE time is doubled.

datacoms.name: Datacom ML4
datacoms.info: Your basic datacom offering. Available just about everywhere, this unit is available in almost all shapes and sizes.

datacoms.name: Terminal-GO
datacoms.info: Why someone would buy one of those is a mystery. Marketed towards corpos with more credits than brains.

datacoms.name: Model RX 66
datacoms.info: A pre war design that has stood the test of time, just make sure to manage your expectations.

datacoms.name: Master VTK
datacoms.info: The VTK is not really a hacker's datacom, it is however a fantastic option for field work when size is not a concern.

datacoms.name: Nanopad
datacoms.info: The legendary Nanopad; amazing capabilities and a hacker's favorite. Its reputation is well established.

datacoms.name: Medesto
datacoms.info: Medesto is one of those datacoms that doesn't quite make sense until you realize how easy it is to modify.

datacoms.name: Gold Board
datacoms.info: Tronik tech available on the high end corpo market. Whether you trust the tech is up to you, but the power is real.

datacoms.name: Avatar III
datacoms.info: What happens when you merge Kraven DNA with a datacom? Apparently, this thing, scary but effective.

datacoms.name: Hackpad
datacoms.info: Immediately banned in every single alliance sector the hackpad was a commercial failure but remains the ultimate hacker status symbol.

datacoms.name: Godlink IV
datacoms.info: The Godlink claims that it's bound to a spirit god. Whether that's true or not is debatable, what is not is just how insane the performance is.

datacoms.name: Model I
datacoms.info: When on a budget, this datacom can do in a pinch, it will beat the snot out of most basic units, just don't expect to look cool doing it.

datacoms.name: Cyber Wraith
datacoms.info: A black market modified datacom equipped to meet the needs of the hacker on the run.

datacoms.name: MBT 33
datacoms.info: The MBT 33 is an experimental liquid Corinthian powered monster that provides its user with insane levels of power.

datacoms.name: Model III
datacoms.info: Most people dismiss the Model III as a corporate tool for people that do not know any better but this datacom packs serious power and should not be underestimated.

datacoms.name: Datavault
datacoms.info: One of the first public offerings of Tronik tech, this datacom has insane data density.

datacoms.name: Speed Master
datacoms.info: The prized possession of many a hacker, the speed master is a staple of most top tier hackers.

datacoms.name: Mister Slick
datacoms.info: Designed for deep corporate espionage, this datacom is custom ordered and built to exact specifications of its discerning customers.

datacoms.name: Vantage
datacoms.info: No one thought the Speed Master could be improved upon, yet here we are.

datacoms.name: Hellion
datacoms.info: A remodelled Hackpad for the corporate market; with more power and still super illegal, not that corporations care.

datacoms.name: SysM-Publix
datacoms.info: The most widespread network in the galaxy. Most space stations, commercial ships and urban centers use some version of it.

datacoms.name: MS-1000
datacoms.info: A commercial offering made from scavenged parts of the legendary MS-5000 network.

datacoms.name: MS-5000
datacoms.info: No one remembers the origins of the MS-5000, all anyone really knows is that it dates before the Tronik uprising and survived it.

datacoms.name: Orion Model VII
datacoms.info: The backbone of the Orion cluster. Finding one in working order today is a rare occurrence.

datacoms.name: Lansing Space Net
datacoms.info: Lansing is known for their exquisite designs, performance and extremely limited availability.

datacoms.name: Nordcorp O.D.I.N
datacoms.info: Little is known about Nordcorp and the O.D.I.N is rumored to be based on some Tronik tech. No one knows for sure because they've never seen one.

actions.name: Cyber Attack
actions.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs the target's WITS. On a hit deal SYSTEM damage (reduces both target SYSTEM and wielder MORALE simultaneously). Expertise cap set by your datacom.
actions.active: Same as passive. In addition choose one benefit: (1) LARGE bonus to the hit roll, (2) LARGE bonus to damage, or (3) apply the hit to a second different target using the same roll result.

actions.name: Disrupt
actions.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs the target's WITS. On a hit apply a SMALL penalty to all of the target's skill rolls until next maintenance.
actions.active: Make a HACKING roll vs the target's WITS. On a hit apply a LARGE penalty to all of the target's skill rolls until next maintenance.

actions.name: Obfuscate
actions.passive: Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs the target's WITS. Each success above the hit threshold increases your obfuscation count by 1. While obfuscated your presence and actions are hidden. Obfuscation count decreases by 1 each time you take any action.
actions.active: Obfuscate gains no additional benefit from control. It is a setup tool, use it before engaging to establish a hidden position before contesting control.

actions.name: Scan
actions.passive: Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs the target's WITS. Each success above the hit threshold steals 1 point of MEMORY value from the target.
actions.active: Same as above but each success above the hit threshold steals 2 points of MEMORY value instead of 1.

actions.name: Lock-On
actions.passive: Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs the target's WITS. On a hit apply one LOCK-ON ailment, target cannot stealth and always grants line of sight (cover still applies). LOCK-ON is stackable: multiple instances must each be saved individually during Phase 1.
actions.active: Lock-On behaves as FULL-AUTO. Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs WITS. On a hit apply LOCK-ON and roll again at -1 success. Each reroll takes a cumulative -1 success penalty. Continue until you miss.

actions.name: Assistance
actions.passive: Grant one ally a SMALL bonus to a specific action of your choice this round. The ally must use it before the start of your next turn or it is lost.
actions.active: Grant one ally a LARGE bonus to a specific action of your choice this round.

programs.name: Sledgehammer
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS with a SMALL bonus to the hit roll. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Cannot be OBFUSCATED while this program is active, its brute-force signature is impossible to hide.
programs.active: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS with a LARGE bonus to the hit roll. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Cannot be OBFUSCATED.

programs.name: Deep Scan
programs.passive: Make a CYBERINTEL roll vs target WITS. On success reveal 1 program or routine currently running on the target network. Gain 1 additional reveal per success above the hit threshold, up to a maximum equal to your EXPERTISE.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition spend additional successes to reveal hidden game state: token counts, bid amounts, obfuscation counts, or programs held in memory.

programs.name: Kernel Panic
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit apply one CPU DRAIN ailment instance, each instance reduces the target's available CPU by 1. Multiple instances stack and are each saved separately during Phase 1.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition steal 1 CPU per active CPU DRAIN instance currently on the target, they lose that CPU, you gain it immediately for this round.

programs.name: Ghost Rig
programs.passive: Grants a LARGE bonus to OBFUSCATE checks. Taking control of devices or networks while obfuscated does not reveal your presence, targets have no indication they are being hacked until obfuscation ends or they successfully detect you.
programs.active: All CYBERINTEL, HACKING and OPERATOR rolls made while obfuscated have a critical success on any result of 5 or higher. On a critical success your obfuscation count does not decrease for that action.

programs.name: Override
programs.passive: Make an OPERATOR roll vs the target's WITS (attended drone: use operator's WITS instead). On success apply DISRUPTED, the drone cannot act this round.
programs.active: Make an OPERATOR roll vs the target's WITS. On success the drone is SEIZED, add it to your network immediately, reserving CPU equal to the drone's core component slots. The original operator may contest seizure each maintenance with an opposed OPERATOR roll.

programs.name: Crypto Cat
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. Steal a number of banked control tokens from the target equal to the SYSTEM damage dealt after mitigation, they lose those tokens, you gain them immediately.
programs.active: Same as passive. This attack gains the XDT property, datacom TECH defense above MEDIUM is treated as MEDIUM for this attack.

programs.name: Nul Protocol
programs.passive: Make a HACKING roll vs target WITS. On hit deal SYSTEM damage. If a single hit exceeds the target's WILLPOWER threshold causing a mental trauma, any operator directly connected to that device simultaneously suffers a MENTAL TRAUMA.
programs.active: Same as passive. In addition any operator who suffers a mental trauma from this attack is also DAZED until next maintenance.

programs.name: Skillsoft (Skill name)
programs.passive: Grants a SMALL bonus to one pre-selected skill (Determined at purchase) [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: Provides an AI that will assist you when performing (pick one skill) checks

programs.name: Data Purge
programs.passive: If an attack would reduce your INTERNAL or CORE SYSTEM to 0, your NETWORK controller RESETS (All routines are offline) but the attack is negated. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: Emergency system reboot designed as a last line of defense against hackers.

programs.name: Cyberwall I
programs.passive: Grants a SMALL bonus to SOAK against TECH damage [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: SOAK reinforcement for a network users.

programs.name: Mr. Fix-it
programs.passive: Any NETWORK NODE running Mr. Fix-It recover 1 SYSTEM during each maintenance. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: Mr. Fix-It monitor's and maintain the SYSTEM of your network.

programs.name: Gorilla backup
programs.passive: You can transfer your entire DATACOM's memory to any other network NODE as a QUICK action (receiving node must have enough memory) [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: Allows rapid movement of data of your network devices MEMORY.

programs.name: Dr Tavish personal assistant
programs.passive: Provides real time translation of any language, including some obscure darkspace dialects. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.desc: Popular commercial grade universal translator

programs.name: McTavish Pro
programs.passive: When your network takes any amount of SYSTEM damage, all NODE owners on the network gain a LARGE bonus to TECH SOAK until next maintenance [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
programs.active: Same as base effect with enhanced results when taking control of this program. [TEMPORARY - Under revision]
